fixed_findings.problem: Standalone upload did not enforce consumer capacity/reference budgets before SDK identity and frozen verification
fixed_findings.fix: Recompute staged capacity, bounded metadata reads, canonical referenced types and sizes, frozen verification before SDK/provider entry
fixed_findings.acceptance: Corrupt, stale, overbudget and wrong-type fixtures rejected before identity; successful local fake upload writes complete matching receipts

fixed_findings.problem: ZIP referenced with JSON suffix bypassed inner ZIP preflight
fixed_findings.fix: Require unchanged producer canonical digest/path/type and bounded index parts
fixed_findings.acceptance: Mislabeled referenced shard is rejected before frozen ZIP parsing

fixed_findings.problem: Git or report error after directory publication could leave partial staging
fixed_findings.fix: Prepare Git metadata/report privately; rollback same-volume published directory if report replace fails
fixed_findings.acceptance: Git/write/replace OSError and cancellation preserve old source and leave no stage/temp; retry succeeds

fixed_findings.problem: KeyboardInterrupt bypassed Exception cleanup for downloads/extraction
fixed_findings.fix: Cleanup owned created files/directories on BaseException
fixed_findings.acceptance: Injected cancellation removes archive and extracted files/directories

fixed_findings.problem: Direct receipt writes could truncate an earlier verified receipt
fixed_findings.fix: Same-directory temporary complete write, flush/fsync, atomic replace; authoritative SHA receipt first; safe failure reporter
fixed_findings.acceptance: Replacement error or cancellation keeps old bytes and no temporary residue; success produces complete JSON

fixed_findings.problem: Member cap alone did not bound implicit directory depth
fixed_findings.fix: Consumer path depth 8, UTF-8 path bytes 1024, staged traversal node budget; bounded and no-link historical receipt reads
fixed_findings.acceptance: Overdepth archive rejected before directory creation; linked previous receipt cannot cause successful skip

fixed_findings.problem: HTML test used Windows default GBK to read UTF-8 output
fixed_findings.acceptance: Full suite passes without forced PYTHONUTF8

remaining.issue: Finite consumer budgets cannot cover unbounded frozen producer metadata
remaining.acceptance: Explicit reject for unsupported input; protocol remains unchanged; representative real inventory/runner resources require separate authorized online acceptance

remaining.issue: 20 GiB expansion/41.25 GiB peak are arithmetic boundary tests, not physical full-budget test
remaining.acceptance: Keep claim scoped; synthetic stress separately measures 64x256 MiB sources

remaining.issue: Real cloud disk capacity, provider upload/readback, online timeouts and natural scheduling not tested
remaining.acceptance: Separate authorized online acceptance; no inferred success from offline or manual reads

remaining.issue: Linux real symlink checks pending by user instruction
remaining.acceptance: Existing strict Linux harness reports all required tests pass, zero skips, on available offline Linux

remaining.issue: Hard termination, host crash, concurrent directory mutation, filesystem metadata/reservations and multi-file/provider transaction are outside offline atomicity guarantee
remaining.acceptance: Do not claim kill/crash/concurrent adversary or cross-file/cloud rollback; per-file complete replacement and ordinary exception/cancellation covered

independent_read_only_reviewer: No remaining definite code defect after atomic receipt fix; Linux pending
merge_conclusion: Code and tested offline domain have no known remaining blocker. Full cross-platform/online acceptance incomplete; keep draft and do not merge.
